summary: CICS online Add User screen (admin function). Captures a new user's id, first name, last name, password and user type, validates all fields are present and valid, checks the user id does not already exist, and writes a new user security record. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the add-user screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to admin menu; Enter process the add; PF4 clear the screen. Return to CICS.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate all fields: first name, last name, user id, password required; user type must be a valid value (e.g. 'A' admin or 'U' user). Check the user id is not already on file (error if it exists). If all valid, write the new user security record.
branches: IF user id already exists -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: first name, last name, user id, password and a valid user type (A/U) are all required to add a user; the user id must be unique.

paragraphs.name: READ-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the user security file by user id to check whether the id already exists.

paragraphs.name: WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the new user security record (id, names, password, type); on error report it.

paragraphs.name: SEND-USRADD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and send the add-user map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-USRADD-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the add-user map from the terminal.
